Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.block

Class SinglesStackBE

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.block.StackBlockEntity
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.block.SinglesStackBE
public class SinglesStackBE extends StackBlockEntity
One Singles Stack: 64 single items drawn as a rotatable 4 x 4 x 4 grid.

A slot index is a cell, not a place in a bag, and every item must sit on one directly below it or on the seam with the Singles Stack beneath. A vertical run of these is a SinglesColumn, which is what automation addresses; this class owns one block's cells, its shape, its layout rotation, and a rotation for each rendered item.

Capability exposure is loader-specific and lives outside this class; StackBlockEntity.getItems() is what a loader-specific capability view adapts.

    • onLocalContentsChanged

      protected void onLocalContentsChanged(int slot)
      Description copied from class: StackBlockEntity

    • column

      @Nullable public SinglesColumn column()
      The column this block belongs to, or null on the client and for a block being removed.

      Resolved once a tick and held, because a machine reading this block's item handler resolves the column once per slot it walks. See StorageStackBE.pile() for the full reasoning.
